scope: Whole entry_fields function lines99-137 read and exact original AST body executed in isolation with authored BytesIO. Additional combined source output truncated; no additional whole-file completion claimed.

findings.detail: entry_fields reads up to65535 bytes regardless of declared entry end. Can parse delimiters and metadata outside that entry and return inverted ECC bounds. Reproduced start11/end4 without exception.

Four find results are not checked for missing or ordered delimiters. Slices using -1 produce fields rather than typed parse refusal; integer conversion error only prints and returns raw bytes. Reproduced.

entry.lstrip(field_delim) removes any leading byte from delimiter byte set, not repetitions of the complete delimiter. Offset calculation still uses original entry start. Metadata leading delimiter-valued bytes require explicit policy; source-level finding.

These are local parser contract violations; whole repair impact and later metadata recovery/validation must be reviewed separately. Do not classify isolated parse acceptance as proven end-to-end corruption.
